evidence.text:
git add -A && git config user.email "openhands@all-hands.dev" && git config user.name "openhands" && git commit -m "blockmatrix: preserve ZeroMatrix blocks in _blockmul results instead of scalar Zero

This ensures that multiplying BlockMatrix objects containing ZeroMatrix
blocks does not convert zero blocks to scalar S.Zero, which caused
AttributeError when computing col/row block sizes on subsequent block
operations. Post-process the block product to replace S.Zero entries
with ZeroMatrix of the appropriate block shape.

Co-authored-by: openhands <openhands@all-hands.dev>"
